title: Evia Pulse
details: The Targets board is now Evia Pulse, with the next review date, current targets, overall wellbeing and overall confidence in one review-ready view
The home target symbol is now a yellow heart with a pulse line while its badge continues to show unfinished targets
Evia asks one lightweight weekly wellbeing check-in using three vertical Evia-style expressions with no emotion labels
Wellbeing history is kept by review period so learners and reviewers can see the pattern since the last review and look back at earlier check-ins
Every completed course subcategory now offers a 1-to-5 confidence check after all of its child evidence sections have evidence
Learners can revisit any completed subcategory in Overall confidence and raise or lower their score later; previous scores are retained as history
Confidence is reflective information only and does not change course completion or evidence progress
summary: Evia v226 adds Evia Pulse: review targets, weekly wellbeing and editable confidence tracking brought together in the existing Targets area.
changes: Replaced the target bullseye with the Pulse heart symbol
Added weekly vertical Evia-expression wellbeing check-ins and history
Added course-wide subcategory confidence checks with 1-to-5 wording
Added editable confidence history and review-period comparison
Preserved the existing Targets board as the Overall targets deep dive
